sloka: निर्विशङ्का निरुद्विग्ना निरपेक्षा च मैथिली ।मामुपस्थास्यते सीता सर्वाभरणभूषिता ।। ६.४७.९ ।।।।
transliteration: nirviśaṅkā nirudvignā nirapekṣā ca maithilī ।māmupasthāsyate sītā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā ।। 6.47.9 ।।।।

translations.english: "Mythili, rid of sorrow and free from perturbation, giving up hope (of Rama) can wait upon me adorned with all kinds of jewels."
